description: This file defines the class JacksonSerializationContext, which implements the SerializationContext interface by providing methods to serialize data into CBOR format using Jackson's JsonGenerator. It manages the writing of various data types and handles an internal output stream to control serialization output.

classes.name: JacksonSerializationContext
classes.description: Implementation of SerializationContext using Jackson's JsonGenerator to handle CBOR serialization, providing methods to write various data types and manage output streams.

classes.name: JacksonSerializationContext.ControllableOutputStream
classes.description: A custom OutputStream that can be enabled or disabled to control whether data is forwarded to the underlying target stream.

methods.name: JacksonSerializationContext
methods.description: Constructor initializing the context with a given Jackson JsonFactory and OutputStream or ByteBuffer.

methods.name: getJacksonGenerator
methods.description: Returns the internal JsonGenerator used for serialization.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the JsonGenerator and its output.

methods.name: writeCachedElement
methods.description: Writes pre-serialized cached data, flushes the generator, and informs Jackson of an element write.

methods.name: writeNull
methods.description: Writes a null value to the output.

methods.name: writeNumber
methods.description: Overloaded methods to write different numeric types (float, double, long, int).

methods.name: writeFieldName
methods.description: Writes a field name for object properties.
